description: Motus Insur - All With History is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Trucking and Motorcoaches", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. This is an All With History dataset. Records for carrier/broker/freight forwarder active or pending individual insurance policies. The records are linked to the entities by docket numbers included in the dataset. The dataset contains information on the insurance policy, including insurance company name, policy number and type of insurance. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Trucking and Motorcoaches". It has 11 columns, among them POLICY_NO, USDOT_NUMBER, INS_TYPE_CODE, DOCKET_NUMBER, UNDERL_LIM_AMOUNT, TRANS_DATE. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
